topic_title: Reduce Risk — Zero Tolerance Practices & Impairment
prompt: What is the official definition of a true 'Designated Driver' according to Texas safety standards?

options.text: The person in the group who has consumed the least amount of draft beer
A motorist who drinks only high-end imported wine rather than distilled spirits
A person who abstains from alcohol entirely for the duration of the gathering
The driver who agrees to drive slowly in the right-hand lane during return trip
